summary: 17 Education & Technology Group Inc., a China-based AI education company listed on NASDAQ (YQ), filed a Form 6-K under U.S. securities rules to announce a newly approved share repurchase program. On September 3, 2026, its board authorized repurchases of up to US$10 million of its ordinary shares, including American depositary shares, over 12 months. The buyback may occur through open-market purchases, private negotiations, block trades, or other legal means based on market conditions, funded from existing cash. The board will periodically review and may adjust the program's terms. No specific price, premium, or advisor is stated. What to watch: execution pace and management's willingness to expand the program if shares remain depressed.
